$comment: Ingest pipeline FMEA (GAU-121). NASA SP-2016-6105 Rev 2 §6.4. Severity/likelihood 1-5; risk = S x L. residualLikelihood is after the mitigation. verifiedBy = exact test names proving the mitigation; gap = what is still missing. Checked by `npm run verify`.

rows.effect: IMF and plasma inputs age; a naive system would keep serving the last value as live
rows.detection: Measurement-age freshness tier; source status lastSeen from data time
rows.mitigation: Carry at most 15 min, then flag stale (tier 3); other sources continue in parallel
verifiedBy: ingest tick: no jitter between fetches, and an over-age readout is dropped (GAU-44)
latest feed: points older than 15 min are served flagged stale (GAU-15)

rows.effect: Tick stalls; all data ages behind one slow source
rows.mitigation: Parallel fetch, per-source time budget, previous value kept
verifiedBy: pipeline timer: a stage past its timeout is abandoned and counted
tick reports per-stage latency, and sources are fetched in parallel

rows.effect: Overlapping ticks publish out of order and hide the slow stage
rows.mitigation: Skip a tick while one is running
verifiedBy: interval never stacks a tick on one still running

rows.failureMode: Format or field change (e.g. temperature read as velocity)
rows.effect: Wrong physical values presented as measurements
rows.detection: Row validation per adapter; source unhealthy
rows.mitigation: Strict parsing; malformed rows rejected, never coerced
verifiedBy: NOAA: RTSW active spacecraft, native GSE, UTC time, no temperature-as-velocity (GAU-48, GAU-51, GAU-56)
ESA: parses nested and flat HAPI B_NEC rows and rejects malformed ones (GAU-50)

rows.effect: Coerced to 0 and published as real data
rows.detection: Range and type checks per value
rows.mitigation: Treated as missing; row or channel skipped
verifiedBy: MMS: fill-valued components are rejected rather than zeroed
GOES: newest valid sample of the S-scale channel; fill and null flux skipped (GAU-112)
Kyoto Dst: newest valid hour, read as UTC; blanks and bad times skipped (GAU-116)

rows.failureMode: Zone-less time read in host local time (UTC+8)
rows.effect: Data shifted by 8 h; freshness wrong
rows.mitigation: Zone-less tags parsed as UTC; invalid rejected
verifiedBy: NOAA: zone-less SWPC time_tags are read as UTC, invalid ones rejected
CSV rows with unparseable times are skipped, and compact times are UTC (GAU-114)

rows.failureMode: Down, timeout, missing route or malformed answer
rows.effect: A naive client invents a forecast or errors to the UI
rows.mitigation: Explicit 'unavailable' with a reason; no number shown
verifiedBy: inference server failures become unavailable with no URL in the reason (GAU-111)
no inference server: forecast is an explicit unavailable, never a number (GAU-111)

rows.effect: Broken deployment silently reads as 'no model deployed'
rows.detection: Load error surfaced in the unavailable reason and /health
rows.mitigation: Promotion gate; load failures reported as such
verifiedBy: Kp model unit tests (python)

rows.failureMode: Skill degrades in operation (drift, regime change)
rows.effect: Forecasts worse than persistence while still served
rows.detection: None live: skill is measured only at promotion
rows.gap: Live skill tracking vs persistence as a technical performance measure (stability plan step 3)

rows.effect: History silently lost; persist stage reported ok
rows.mitigation: Point still served from memory; failure surfaced, not swallowed
verifiedBy: FMEA: a failed telemetry write is counted and reported, and the tick still publishes (GAU-121)
FMEA: best-effort appends never reject (no unhandled rejection); strict appends do; both count (GAU-121)
bedrock skips corrupt and torn lines instead of returning nothing (GAU-117)

rows.effect: Memory buffer empty: history lost and forecast blind for 6 h
rows.mitigation: Last 24 h reloaded from bedrock before the worker starts; launchd KeepAlive restarts the process
verifiedBy: restart reload fills an empty buffer once, in order, and never duplicates (GAU-117)

rows.effect: Whole service down: single point of failure
rows.detection: Pipeline verdict 'stalled' after 3 missed ticks; HUD shows STALLED
rows.mitigation: Auto-restart on wake; no standby host
verifiedBy: pipeline timer: status follows data age and loop liveness
rows.gap: Warm standby host with data replication (stability plan step 5)

rows.effect: All writes fail; services may crash
rows.detection: failedWrites after the fact; no proactive disk-space monitor
rows.gap: Free-space technical performance measure with a threshold alert (stability plan step 3)

verifiedBy: caps coupling window length to prevent unbounded memory growth
canonical feed keeps a fixed-size ring buffer

rows.failureMode: Skew: points stamped in the future
rows.effect: Wrong forecast window; data looks fresher than it is
rows.detection: Window and freshness checks against now
rows.mitigation: Future points excluded from the forecast window
verifiedBy: forecast window: last 6 h of measured points, one per minute (GAU-115)

rows.failureMode: Abuse: floods, malicious payloads, credential stuffing
rows.mitigation: Block, rate-limit, auto-block on auth failures
verifiedBy: blocks malicious signature and places IP on blocklist
rate limits after max requests within configured window
auth failure threshold auto-blocks IP

rows.failureMode: Stale or missing data shown as nominal
rows.detection: UI view-model checks freshness and tier
verifiedBy: HUD never shows stale or missing data as fresh
measured drivers come only from current, complete measurements (GAU-114)
